news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics (PRCT) Stock May Be Fully Priced On Cash Flow Hopes
news.summary: A valuation note argues that after the late-October rebound the share price may already reflect expectations of future cash-flow improvement. It is a counterweight to bullish takes ahead of the November 4 Q3 report, where cash burn and the path to profitability will be scrutinized.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics: Compelling Bet On Aquablation's Growth
news.summary: A bullish Seeking Alpha piece argues Aquablation adoption and procedure growth make PROCEPT a compelling long at depressed valuations ahead of Q3 results.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Shares Climb 7.6%
news.summary: PRCT shares rose about 7.6% in one session, extending a late-October rebound from around $18-19 with no new company announcement; Wall Street consensus remains Hold.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 4th, 2026
news.summary: PROCEPT will release Q3 2026 results on November 4, 2026. Investors will look for progress against the reiterated $390-410M full-year revenue guidance.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics to Attend the Baird 2026 Global Healthcare Conference on September 15, 2026
news.summary: Management presented and held investor meetings at Baird's conference in New York on September 15.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $94.5M (+19% YoY) with U.S. procedures above 13,100 (about +21%) and 65 U.S. HYDROS systems delivered. Gross margin rose to 66% and full-year revenue guidance of $390-410M was reiterated; WATER IV prostate cancer enrollment was completed.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Confirmed on October 12-13 for November 4. Key test for U.S. HYDROS system placements and procedure growth (Q2: 13,100+ U.S. procedures, +21%) against the reiterated $390-410M full-year revenue guide, plus gross-margin trajectory and operating-expense discipline.

pulse: PROCEPT shares rebounded to around $19-20 in the second half of October, with single-session gains of about 4-8% on October 20-22, but remain well below their highs, with Wall Street consensus at Hold and weekend commentary split between bullish Aquablation-growth takes and valuation caution. Q2 revenue grew 19% to $94.5M with 66% gross margin, guidance of $390-410M was reiterated, and WATER IV prostate-cancer enrollment is complete. No new company business news since the Q3 date notice; November 4 results are the next catalyst.
